scope: Retrospective endpoint-identification diagnostic, not a prayer-time accuracy result or fitted runtime rule.
endpointArithmetic: Exact rational image of stored IEEE754 binary64 model endpoints; no tolerance in feasibility.
sourceConstraints: u-1/2 <= line(x) < u+1/2; u is an integer UTC minute relative to unchanged carrier.

units.endpointAndInterceptValues: UTC-clock minutes relative to each solar carrier midnight

limits: The stored model endpoints and proxy points are conditional hypotheses, not institutional coordinates or source raw seconds.
Free slope/intercept existence is an identification statement; no feasible line is selected as a calculator.
Per-event fixed-point rejection is confounded with an unknown additive clock shift; per-city two-event intersections test a shared-shift explanation under unchanged endpoint days.
A longitude change can also affect date/rule choices outside the fixed conditions; latitude, elevation and alternative methods are not identified here.
Endpoint trims are separate declared diagnostics, not exclusions from the main cohort or new runtime policies.
The main Helsinki Isha interval conflict touches only at a rounding tie; it does not exclude every alternative tie convention.
